strict_interpretation: Expected identities, contract and authority come from trusted external inputs, not self-asserted approved flags
Reject unknown revision/enum, duplicate keys, wrong exact types, missing required fields and cross-run/clock/Job references
Unknown required evidence is not made optional to allow acceptance
No coercion of null, empty string, false, numeric zero, omitted field or summary PASS into valid evidence
Source event time and source sequence may be null when not available; receive/observation time is separate
First cause reference may be null only if that class has no observed cause up to the linked ledger boundary
Current and sampled maximum are expressly null for the notification mode; not valid legacy current samples

ledger.hash_preimage: Exact completed stored bytes of the prior record; record body does not contain its own full-record hash
ledger.self_identity_location: External index or next record reference, not a self-referential byte hash
ledger.genesis: First record has previous_record_sha256=null and a required externally expected genesis/run-start reference
ledger.continuity: Contiguous sequence within one ledger, one previous hash, no forks, gaps, changed object IDs or reordered records

required_axes.fixed_new_mode_meaning: NOT_MEASURED_BY_NOTIFICATION, null, null; raw JobMemory stays event evidence

noncyclic_evidence_objects.post_write_identity_and_readback_locatio: Separate post-write/readback records and C reference completed P; P is never rewritten to include them

noncyclic_evidence_objects.primary_display_reason: Optional and not a replacement for all causes

acceptance_rules: Verify external expectations, structure, exact stored identities and raw evidence references first; unbound material cannot prove a violation in this run
Any null or unadopted required duration prevents event_channel_bound and normal acceptance
Any violation/stop/error/expiry/inhibit, unresolved notification, cap/resource/clock/budget/authority/evidence_IO defect blocks normal acceptance; retain all simultaneous causes
Normal native outcome, confirmed owned termination, required cleanup, selected-scope closure and preservation must each satisfy the adopted contract; forced termination is not normal completion
Verify P and C and actual completed storage readback; then recheck latest shared latch/version and Parent-local causes at the decision boundary
A relevant change after the verified snapshot rejects that snapshot; any recheck stays within the original final and superior deadlines, no automatic reseal
Later or failed record delivery is disclosed as unaccepted/preservation-incomplete; no recursive claim that a record certified its own future write
Only a future separately adopted and verified implementation can produce bounded-scope acceptance; no current-measurement PASS or all-historical-events guarantee
After first error no new normal final writer/readback/clock call; failure verification and evidence preservation remain separate
First observed cause follows supervisor observation/serialization order; source timestamps or later success never rewrite latches or first references
remaining_schema_work: Raw-byte encoding and field canonicalization if used
Safe file/handle identity and path handling
Actual Parent consumer and schema migration
